title: Adjust brightness and contrast
summary: Use Colors, Brightness-Contrast to lighten a photo and compare the result.

steps.say: Open a photo with Control O, or check that one is already showing in the middle.

checks.prompt: Is an image open and visible in the middle of the GIMP window?

hints: Use File, then Open, and pick any JPG from your Pictures folder.
Dragging a photo file onto the GIMP window opens it too.
steps.why: Every edit needs an open image to act on.

steps.say: Open the Colors menu and choose Brightness-Contrast.

checks.prompt: Is the Brightness-Contrast dialog open with Brightness and Contrast sliders?

hints: Colors sits in the menu bar between Layer and Tools.
Press Alt and C to open the Colors menu from the keyboard.
steps.why: This tool lightens or darkens the whole layer in one go.

steps.say: Drag the Brightness slider to the right until the photo looks lighter.

check.prompt: Does the photo look brighter than at the start of this step?

hints: You can click the number box and type a value such as 20.
Drag down or up inside the image to change brightness too.
steps.why: Brightness lifts the overall lightness of the photo.

steps.say: Drag the Contrast slider a little to the right.

check.prompt: Does the photo show stronger contrast than at the start of this step?

hints: Small values, around 10 to 20, usually look natural.
Typing in the number box works too.
steps.why: Contrast spreads lights and darks further apart.

steps.say: Untick Preview to compare with the original, then tick it again.

checks.prompt: Is the Preview box ticked in the Brightness-Contrast dialog?

hints: Preview is a checkbox near the bottom of the dialog.
Say done when you have compared both versions.
steps.why: Comparing keeps you from overdoing the effect.

steps.say: Click OK to apply the change.

checks.prompt: Is the Brightness-Contrast dialog closed with the photo looking brighter?

hints: Press Enter to click OK from the keyboard.
Control Z undoes it if you do not like the result.
steps.why: OK writes the change into the layer.
